label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss) is alert-TP. The sink expression response.getWriter().println(param) outputs user-supplied data from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') directly to the response body without HTML encoding or sanitization. Although the execution is gated by a principal name check, this is a logical guard rather than a mitigation technique (sanitizer/encoder). The resolved sink value is attacker-controlled input, making this a true positive XSS vulnerability.

evidence.note: param sourced from request.getParameter is echoed to response.getWriter() without encoding
